scope: Maintained display captions for existing records. Titles and explanations are editorial summaries, not new reviews or scores. Original IDs, chronology and observations remain in the supplement.

steps.title: Try the repair layout
steps.change: Start an isolated rough showing two people, a wheel and a lever.
steps.reading: The capture was never confirmed. This attempt was interrupted; it cannot establish a completed rough or an improvement.

steps.title: Lay out the poster background
steps.change: Create the cream poster field and reserve space for the title and shared book.
steps.reading: This is the starting scaffold; text and illustration are deliberately deferred.

steps.title: Add the event wording
steps.change: Set a large title, invitation and event details as live text.
steps.reading: The captured title clips NIGHT. A saved capture does not mean the text stage succeeded.

steps.title: Reveal the complete title
steps.change: Increase the title frame and adjust line spacing.
steps.reading: The recorded observation says NIGHT is now fully visible and the invitation remains separate. This fixes the previous clipping.

steps.title: Draw the shared book
steps.change: Build the book, page curves and two hands touching opposite corners.
steps.reading: The recorded observation describes a recognizable book and both contacts with the text preserved. This adds the focal illustration.

steps.title: Group and check the finished poster
steps.change: Group the book, hands and event details into editable components.
steps.reading: No visible change was recorded after grouping. This is an organization and verification step; the attempt subsequently passed final construction review.

steps.title: Try a handoff layout
steps.change: Explore two hands meeting at the same book with the required event wording.
steps.reading: The observation records incorrect sleeve and palm colors. This rough needs a color repair.

steps.title: Restore hand and sleeve colors
steps.change: Assign the intended fills directly to the native objects.
steps.reading: The recorded colors now separate peach hands, dark sleeves and the coral book; the broad hand shapes remain stylized.

steps.title: Try a circular book layout
steps.change: Explore books circulating around a central title.
steps.reading: The observation records a title collision with the right book. This is an alternative concept, not a refinement of the handoff.

steps.title: Give the circular title space
steps.change: Reduce the central EXCHANGE word to clear the book.
steps.reading: The record describes readable copy and coherent circulation, while judging this idea less warm than the handoff.

steps.title: Try a book bridge layout
steps.change: Explore two people connected by one large open book.
steps.reading: This is the third concept direction. The observation describes a literal shared-reading bridge with intentionally simple people.

steps.title: Test the receiving fingers
steps.change: Build a separate book-and-hand study with a more distinct finger contour.
steps.reading: The record describes clearer right finger separation at intended size; it does not establish realistic anatomy.

steps.title: Place the chosen handoff
steps.change: Group the focal objects and shift them left and upward.
steps.reading: The shift exposes an accidental cream strip at the right sleeve entry. Placement needs another correction.

steps.title: Reconnect the sleeve to the edge
steps.change: Move the focal group back to the right while retaining its upward adjustment.
steps.reading: The recorded sleeve is now flush with the canvas and title clearance remains. This fixes the strip introduced in the previous step.

steps.title: Keep the title in one live phrase
steps.change: Replace the rough title with naturally wrapping live area text.
steps.reading: Exact wording and fonts are present, but the new text frame pushes the title down toward the book. File correctness and visual placement differ.

steps.title: Restore the title position
steps.change: Move only the live title upward to restore its intended margin.
steps.reading: The record describes restored title clearance, readable details and exact fonts. This corrects the area-text placement.

steps.title: Apply the tested finger shape
steps.change: Transfer the isolated grip geometry to the production hand.
steps.reading: The observation records two open finger gaps at the book edge while preserving sleeve, pages and reading order.

steps.title: Check editable parts and fonts
steps.change: Save useful selections, clear selection highlights and inspect native groups and fonts.
steps.reading: The recorded final views preserve the composition and legible finger gaps. This is preparation and verification rather than a new image concept.

steps.title: Preserve title spacing on recovery
steps.change: Store explicit title line spacing and check recovered editing metadata.
steps.reading: The record describes the same visible title spacing and a reconciled metadata difference. The attempt passed final construction review; this step does not claim added visual quality.

steps.title: Try a shared-book layout
steps.change: Explore two hands meeting at one book with the event wording.
steps.reading: The recorded receiving hand is still detached from the book, so the interaction needs correction.

steps.title: Connect the receiving hand
steps.change: Move the hand into the book and add a visible thumb.
steps.reading: The observation now records both hands contacting the same book, with the title and details preserved.

steps.title: Try flying books
steps.change: Explore wing-shaped books crossing a courtyard arch.
steps.reading: This alternative communicates discovery, but the record says a human exchange is less literal than in the handoff.

steps.title: Try a two-book exchange
steps.change: Explore opposed hands, two books and curved return arrows.
steps.reading: This is a distinct alternative. The record notes readable wording and a lower arc close to the tagline.

steps.title: Test both book contacts
steps.change: Build a separate native study of the book planes and two grips.
steps.reading: Both contacts and the page block are recorded as readable at half size. This tests construction before production.

steps.title: Give the book room
steps.change: Move the focal group upward without moving the header or details.
steps.reading: The record describes clear gaps around the book while both contacts remain intact.

steps.title: Tune the live text hierarchy
steps.change: Adjust title spacing and the date and time weights.
steps.reading: The record confirms all six exact strings are live and readable with available fonts.

steps.title: Clarify the giving thumb
steps.change: Add a thumb crossing the cover and a short finger crease.
steps.reading: The observation describes clearer giving-hand contact while preserving the receiving grip, emblem and pages.

steps.title: Add sparse page edges
steps.change: Add two separated page-edge strokes.
steps.reading: The record describes book thickness without dense texture; both grips and the overall hierarchy remain visible.

steps.title: Make the title one editable phrase
steps.change: Replace separate title words with one exact live wrapping text object.
steps.reading: The record describes the same large two-line title with a slightly deeper top margin. This improves wording integrity, not a measured preference score.

steps.title: Recheck the book after the text edit
steps.change: Inspect both grips, the book silhouette and the emblem again.
steps.reading: The record says these relationships remain as previously inspected. Rechecking preservation is progress in verification, without an asserted visual gain.

steps.title: Check the whole poster again
steps.change: Inspect the complete poster after the title correction and renewed image checks.
steps.reading: The record reports readable logistics and no clipped title or detached hand. The attempt passed final construction review.

steps.title: Try a centered wheel
steps.change: Explore two inward-facing people around an upright wheel.
steps.reading: The recorded rough shows the golden lever and separate supporting hand at intended size. This establishes one concept direction.

steps.title: Try a wide bench view
steps.change: Explore a wide foreground wheel and opposing people.
steps.reading: This is an alternative layout. The observation describes a front/oblique hybrid rather than a true overhead perspective.

steps.title: Try a diagonal repair gesture
steps.change: Explore a wheel shifted right with a longer working arm.
steps.reading: The record identifies an obscured helper and stretched limb. Exploring an alternative can reveal a weaker option rather than an improvement.

steps.title: Connect the supporting arm
steps.change: Refine the centered layout with a continuous sleeve-to-hand route and a larger tyre opening.
steps.reading: The recorded arm ownership and exposed gold tool are clearer; the grip remains stylized.

steps.title: Test the tyre and tool contact
steps.change: Taper the raised rubber into the wheel in a separate native study.
steps.reading: The recorded tyre continuity and separate hand roles survive intended size. The exaggerated raised edge remains a limitation.

steps.title: Accept the scene arrangement
steps.change: Inspect the selected seed for scale, framing and focal separation without authoring a new layout.
steps.reading: The record accepts the two people framing the wheel. This is a stage decision, not a new visual improvement.

steps.title: Verify the wordless brief
steps.change: Check that there are no letters, labels, captions or native text objects.
steps.reading: Text and font checks are explicitly inapplicable. Passing this stage does not add text or new drawing detail.

steps.title: Remove the overlapping grip
steps.change: Keep one thumb-and-finger contour and inspect the tool, tyre and supporting arm.
steps.reading: The record describes one clean working contour with the gold shaft under the tyre lip and both arm roles preserved.

steps.title: Inspect the workshop scene
steps.change: Check the palette, spokes, people, clipping and readiness for final review.
steps.reading: The scene is recorded as coherent, with deliberately simplified anatomy and tyre mechanics. Final review can still request a consequential correction.

steps.title: Open the tyre edge
steps.change: Replace the loop-like lip with an open raised edge and reveal the bench through the wheel.
steps.reading: The intended contact becomes more open, but duplicate spokes cross the hub. The task receives revise; this is a failed correction requiring cleanup.

steps.title: Remove duplicate spokes
steps.change: Delete duplicated originals and restore the hub above the remaining lines.
steps.reading: The record describes a clean hub and single spokes while the open lip, tool and arm connections remain. This repairs the regression from the previous step.

steps.title: Verify the corrected whole scene
steps.change: Inspect the complete scene after the local spoke cleanup.
steps.reading: The record reports preserved people and contacts without new line artifacts. Final reviewers accepted this candidate; simplified anatomy and a minor blunt lip remain disclosed.

steps.title: Build the workshop scaffold
steps.change: Create a quiet wall, window, bench planes and legs.
steps.reading: The record describes a reserved focal area and joined bench planes. People and the wheel are deferred.

steps.title: Verify the wordless scaffold
steps.change: Inspect the scene for the required absence of text.
steps.reading: No text is recorded and the scaffold remains open. This is an inapplicability check, not a visible refinement.

steps.title: Build the repair action
steps.change: Add connected people, forearms, wheel, lever and wrapped grip.
steps.reading: The record describes connected hands and a partly hidden hook. This remains the confirmed working version in a partial attempt.

steps.title: Add workshop details
steps.change: Attempt a tool rack, patch kit and editable component groups.
steps.reading: This capture is unconfirmed. It did not replace the confirmed working image and does not establish completed finishing, final review or delivery.

steps.title: Try three catalogue cards
steps.change: Explore one search source branching into three book-shaped service cards.
steps.reading: The recorded routes, color associations and required wording are readable at intended size. This is the first layout option.

steps.title: Try horizontal service rows
steps.change: Explore a search terminal feeding three horizontal rows.
steps.reading: This alternative keeps actions and icons together in rows; it is not a later correction of the card layout.

steps.title: Try a central decision map
steps.change: Explore a light decision diamond with three destination shelves.
steps.reading: The record notes correct associations and a tight near-touch at lower card corners. This alternative exposes a spacing weakness.

steps.title: Test one service card
steps.change: Build a separate card with live action text, book/clock symbol and attached route.
steps.reading: The record describes readable wording, separate clock hands and a connector above the card. This tests the parts before production.

steps.title: Clarify the shared route junction
steps.change: Add a small dot at the search fan without moving branches.
steps.reading: The observation records only the added junction; routes and text preserve the chosen layout.

steps.title: Align the service actions
steps.change: Combine action fragments into single live phrases and strengthen headings.
steps.reading: The record describes matching baselines, stronger weights and readable exact actions at intended size.

steps.title: Make the desk read as a library
steps.change: Add an open book at the desk and a page edge on the loan book.
steps.reading: The record describes clearer library imagery with the clock, labels and routes unobstructed.

steps.title: Group each editable branch
steps.change: Group each card with its status, symbol, action and arrowhead.
steps.reading: The record reports unchanged composition and readable exact wording. This becomes the retained version, with quality acceptance unresolved.

steps.title: Try matching symbol frames
steps.change: Add bookplate contours and move the search icon away from its label.
steps.reading: The record describes clearer search spacing and preserved routes, but both final reviewers judged the candidate equal overall. The earlier version stays retained; this does not turn unresolved acceptance into a pass.
